charts.title: HIP 9618 c: orbits around HIP 9618
charts.description: The orbits of HIP 9618's planets in this map from above, to scale, with HIP 9618 c highlighted and the direction to Earth down. Each orbit is the one the app draws, from the published period, a/R*, eccentricity and argument of periastron; the star is a marker, not to scale.

metadata.orbitSource: Osborn et al. 2023 (2023MNRAS.523.3069O), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table (pl_refname OSBORN_ET_AL__2023): P 52.563491 d

charts.title: HIP 9618 c: its transit
charts.description: HIP 9618 c crossing its star, as TESS recorded it: 3 sectors (70, 71, 85) of the SPOC pipeline's 2-minute light curves of TIC 306263608, each transit divided by a straight line fitted to the light either side and folded onto the orbit the app draws, moved 10 minutes later to where TESS measures the dip, inside the published ephemeris's 3-sigma uncertainty of 11 minutes at these dates, then averaged in 26-minute bins. Error bars are each bin's standard error.
notes: Aligned on TESS's dip, 10 min late; 26-min bins.
The ephemeris's own 1σ there is 4 min.
Bars: standard error of each bin.
